page.layout: One printed page, single text column in the centre; faint show-through text from the facing page in the right margin, not transcribed. Running head at top; catchword "Quæ-" at the lower right of the text block.

main_text.p: nobis morosò cerebro deliras: Ad plebem usque cultum est ævum hoc, & novis inventis insigne, & habet, si rectè ponderas, quod cum præcedentibus omnibus de nitore & festivitate contendat: Manum exere: aude aliquid,

p.i: ——— Et te quoque dignum Finge Deo:

main_text.p: Videbis minimum adhuc esse, quod majoribus nostris actum est, immensam esse segetem, in quam illi falcem non miserunt: Occupata non est, etiamnum maximâ parte latet Veritas: Communem illam viam aberrantium pedes triverunt; aliâ tendendum est.

page.notes: Show-through from the facing page (right margin and faint lower text) is not transcribed. The word "morosò" is printed with an acute accent over the o and read as written. Some letters in the first lines are slightly worn but legible.
